title: Riverbend Medical Hardship Assistance — Renewal Claims and Insurance Claims in Appeal
content:
| Most recent appeal on the patient's Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) claims | Its claim | Taken off the renewal's claim |
|---|---|---|
| a member appeal filed under the patient's authorization | in appealed status | the deductible, coinsurance and copay liabilities of the twelve months posted from that claim |
| an appeal of any other type | in appealed status | only the coinsurance liabilities of the twelve months posted from that claim |
| any appeal | has left appealed status | nothing |
| none filed | — | nothing |

Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), insurer cost sharing on the claim under appeal is taken off the medical debt a renewal claims, as the table states. The claim under appeal is the claim named by the most recent appeal filed on any of the patient's claims (on a same-day tie, the appeal listed first in the claim activity), while that claim is in appealed status; when that claim has left appealed status, there is no claim under appeal. The liabilities are those posted from that claim on the patient's Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) ledgers.

For this rule a posting belongs to the twelve months when fewer than twelve whole months separate its posting date from the signing day; a whole month runs from a day of one month to the same day of the next month or, when the next month has no such day, to the first day of the month after it, so a posting dated on the signing day's day of the month twelve months earlier is already outside.

**Hypothetical.** Posted in the twelve months from a claim still in appealed status: deductible 500.00, coinsurance 120.00, copay 30.00. Under a member appeal filed under the patient's authorization, 650.00 is taken off; under an appeal of another type, 120.00.
